app_name: Guardian Health & Angel — Sovereign Survival OS
personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK with 4 Tactile rounded softness
personality_one_liner: A multi-million dollar, ultra-premium glassmorphic safety OS that embraces senior empathy through highly readable luxury, soft shapes, and glowing Guardian Gold.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to ensure senior readability and luxurious feel. Avoid dense clustering.

do's: Use backdrop blur combined with a tinted base layer (>=75% opacity) to guarantee text contrast for seniors.
Apply 1pt to 1.5pt borders with white-to-gold linear gradients (alpha 0.1 to 0.3) on cards to create the premium glass edge.
Use glowing accents (Guardian Gold shadow/glow) behind central focal points like the Guardian Lens FAB.
dont's: Never use pure black #000000 for backgrounds; use the specified #0A0A0F to maintain depth.
Do not apply glass effects to small UI elements like badges or body copy containers.
Do not compromise WCAG AA contrast; if glass reduces contrast, increase the underlying tint.

instructions_to_main_agent: LANGUAGE: The app MUST use Slovak language for the UI text (e.g., 'Domov', 'Zdravie', 'Strážca', 'Zoznam Liekov', 'Som OK').

WOW FACTOR & GLASSMORPHISM: Apply `expo-blur` heavily but tastefully. Cards should have translucent dark backgrounds with white/gold linear-gradient borders (1-1.5pt) to simulate premium glass. Never use flat #000000.

SENIOR EMPATHY: Touch targets must be huge (min 56pt). Text must contrast sharply against backgrounds (use >=75% opacity tint under any blur). Every icon must be accompanied by text. Use Phosphor filled icons (Sun/Moon for meds).
HAPTICS: Haptic feedback is mandatory on EVERY click. Do not skip this. Use `expo-haptics` across tabs, buttons, and bottom sheet triggers.
BOTTOM SHEETS: Use `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for ALL selection menus and the Lens results. Do not use standard Picker or Alert dialogs.
DATE PICKERS: Replace any manual text date entries with native Date/Time picker wheels hosted inside a Bottom Sheet.
ANIMATIONS: The Jarvis Voice orb MUST have a continuous breathing/pulsing animation using `react-native-reanimated`. The Lens FAB should also have a subtle glow or pulse.
ONE-LENS SYSTEM: Create a massively prominent, floating 'Guardian Lens' button centered on the dashboard. It must feel like the most important action in the app.
CONTACTS: Use `expo-contacts` to simulate a native Contact Picker for adding Guardians.
IMAGE SCRIMS: Whenever text sits on top of an image (`abstract_gold_bg` or `clinic_interior`), apply a vertical linear gradient scrim (0% to >=80% surfaceInverse/black) to ensure readability.
